First release of `node-red-contrib-s7-rust`: Node-RED nodes for Siemens S7 PLCs, with the
protocol clients written in Rust and running inside the Node-RED process. It is the next
generation of `@oriolrius/node-red-contrib-s7`.

## Highlights

- **Two protocols:** classic S7comm (S7-200/300/400/1200/1500, LOGO! 8) and S7CommPlus
  (S7-1200/1500) with symbolic access to optimized DBs, TLS and password login.
- **Five nodes:** `s7 endpoint`, `s7 read`, `s7 write`, `s7 watch` (with a conditional rate)
  and `s7 info` (CPU state, SZL, clock, blocks, browse, alarms).
- **Fast and light:** no child process and no IPC; reads are grouped into as few requests as
  the PDU allows; changes are detected on the raw PLC bytes.
- **Linux x64 only**, prebuilt for glibc ≥ 2.28 and musl (Alpine, the Node-RED Docker image).
- Licence LGPL-3.0-only. The README has the exact map of the S7 functions that are covered.

## Upgrade notes

New package: install `node-red-contrib-s7-rust` from the palette. It does not replace
`@oriolrius/node-red-contrib-s7` in existing flows.
